bankr_policy: Use only the live Bankr token registry/portfolio at runtime; do not hard-code an asserted 23-token inventory.

resonance_model.swirl: bidirectional state visualization around the gate graph
resonance_model.double: two synchronized render channels per gate: authorization + execution
resonance_model.entanglement_claim: visual/logical synchronization only; not a claim of physical quantum entanglement

eleven_token_lanes.rule: 11 active lanes may be mapped dynamically from the verified live Bankr asset set; remaining lanes stay unbound until verified.
eleven_token_lanes.lane_policy: Each lane references a token contract, chain, symbol, decimals, price source, liquidity status, and timestamp. Missing proof disables the lane.

mapping.11_lanes_to_22_gates: one lane may represent an inbound/outbound pair of gates, but authorization remains independently evaluated at every gate
mapping.POINHI: primary entitlement token only after verified contract configuration
mapping.NFTQR: alternate entitlement proof only after verified contract configuration

runtime.live_registry_source: Bankr quote-token/portfolio endpoints where authenticated access is available
runtime.price_rule: display current verified quote with timestamp; never fabricate market price
runtime.transaction_rule: verify chain, token contract, recipient, amount, nonce/receipt and final order state

render_spec.geometry: two opposing spiral fields around a 22-node gate ring
render_spec.animation: deterministic phase rotation driven by verified state changes
render_spec.accessibility: reduced-motion mode and text-only gate status
